items.name: TheRouter
items.description: An OpenAI-compatible AI gateway that its about page says is run by Wrise, LLC. Its docs cover setup for Cursor and Claude Code, model fallbacks and per-request token and cost data in every response. Pay-as-you-go per-token prices are published; you can also bring your own provider keys, though the pricing page says a platform fee may still apply and doesn't say how much.

items.name: AIHOT Model Leaderboard
items.description: A free Chinese-language model leaderboard, run as a personal project, that needs no registration. It ranks models only on scores that third-party evaluators measured themselves, leaves out vendor-reported scores, publishes its category weights and links each per-model score to the evaluator's original result.

items.name: GeminiReset
items.description: An independent tracker, not affiliated with Google, that logs announced Gemini quota resets in Google Antigravity. Entries come only from a short list of named X accounts and link the original post, and its methodology page explains how they're checked. It doesn't predict resets. RSS and calendar feeds are available.
